{"script":"cat > solution.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

dir="log_files"
cutoff=$(date -d '7 days ago' +%s)
sum=0

is_prime() {
  local n=$1 i
  (( n >= 2 )) || return 1
  for ((i=2; i*i<=n; i++)); do
    (( n % i )) || return 1
  done
  return 0
}

shopt -s nullglob
for file in "$dir"/log_server_*_*.txt; do
  base=${file##*/}
  [[ $base =~ ^log_server_([0-9]+)_[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\.txt$ ]] || continue
  id=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
  is_prime "$id" || continue

  created=$(stat -c %W "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  if [[ $created -le 0 ]]; then
    created=$(stat -c %Y "$file")
  fi
  (( created >= cutoff )) || continue

  file_sum=$(awk '{s += $1} END {print s + 0}' "$file")
  (( sum += file_sum ))
done

printf '%s\n' "$sum"
EOF
chmod +x solution.sh
bash -n solution.sh"}
